Name: Abigail Dynamic Weight Gain
Author: TentAlt
Description:
Dynamically changes Abigail's portraits and sprites corresponding to friendship level with the player, adding to her figure and face. Mod includes five weight phases, with three variants at Abigail's max weight

This is my first mod ever, and pretty rudementary, watch for more updates!

Requirements:
Content Patcher, SMAPI

Installation:
Unzip the file into the Stardew Valley mods folder.

Credits to gunbuster7, who designed the sprite sheets based Dizor's original designs.
